tools.name: search
tools.description: Resolve a name to Kerbside drivers, teams (marques) and races, with their Kerbside URLs. A driver slug is the last part of its URL (/drivers/<slug>); other tools take that slug.

tools.name: championship_standings
tools.description: Drivers' championship standings of a season after a given round (default: the latest round with results), with the points each driver scored in that round. The final round of a finished season is the final championship table: the champion and the margin.

tools.name: championship_math
tools.description: For the current season: each driver's and constructor's points, the most they can still score in the remaining races (today's points table, sprints included), and whether they can still win the title.

tools.name: power_ranking
tools.description: Kerbside's Power Score ranking of a season's drivers (default weights), with the four component scores. A site-defined metric: the definition is returned with the data.

tools.name: teammate_head_to_head
tools.description: Qualifying and race head-to-head between two drivers who were teammates (from 1981), overall and per season, for each team they shared.

tools.name: peak_finder
tools.description: Drivers ranked by their best run of 3, 5 or 10 consecutive seasons (every season raced), by points, wins, podiums or win rate.

tools.name: driver_milestones
tools.description: Active drivers close to a round-number career milestone (e.g. 100th podium) or an all-time team record, with how far off they are.

tools.name: lap1_performance
tools.description: Per driver, the average places gained or lost on the opening lap over a season's races and sprints (seasons with position data: 2023 on).

tools.name: what_if
tools.description: A season's drivers' championship re-scored with another points system, beside the actual standings. Systems, by points from 1st down: current 25-18-15-12-10-8-6-4-2-1 + fastest lap; classic 10-6-4-3-2-1; pre2003 10-8-6-5-4-3-2-1; winner_takes_all 25; linear 20…1.

tools.name: get_record
tools.description: One all-time driver record board from /records, top N with every driver tied at the cut.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
